## Installing packages and setting working directory

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(plm)
library(fixest)
library(dplyr)
library(modelsummary)
library(tinytable)
library(stargazer)
library(margins)

gtfs <- read_csv("/Users/ahmadalexander/Desktop/python/eco590/final-project-Ahmad-Alexander/data/bus_bunching.csv")
```

## Cleaning data

```{r cars}
# Making categorical variables
gtfs <- gtfs %>%
  mutate(
    agency = factor(agency, levels = c("MBTA", "MTA", "WMATA")),
    direction = factor(direction),
    route_id = factor(route_id),
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"),
      labels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
    ),
    day_of_week = relevel(day_of_week, ref = "Friday")
  )
```

## Summary Stats

```{r stats}
outpath <-setwd("/Users/ahmadalexander/Desktop/python/eco590/final-project-Ahmad-Alexander/output")

# Getting summary stats
summary_vars <- subset(gtfs, select = c(deviation, bunching, scheduled_headway, peak,
                                         n_stops, timepoint_rate, route_length_mi, headway_cv))

stargazer(
  as.data.frame(summary_vars),
  type = "html",
  title = "Table 1: Summary Statistics",
  covariate.labels = c(
    "Headway Deviation",
    "Bunching",
    "Scheduled Headway",
    "Peak Hour",
    "Number of Stops",
    "Timepoint Rate",
    "Route Length",
    "Headway CV"
  ),
  summary.stat = c("mean", "sd", "min", "max", "n"),
  digits = 2,
  out = paste0(outpath, "summary_stats.html")
)

browseURL("summary_stats.html")
```

## Regressions

```{r regressions}
# Model 1: Pooled OLS, no fixed effects
model1 <- plm(
  deviation ~ agency + scheduled_headway + peak + direction +
    n_stops + timepoint_rate + route_length_mi + headway_cv,
  data = gtfs,
  model = "pooling"
)
summary(model1)

# Model 2: Pooled OLS, day fixed effects
model2 <- plm(
  deviation ~ agency + scheduled_headway + peak + direction +
    n_stops + timepoint_rate + route_length_mi + headway_cv +
    day_of_week,
  data = gtfs,
  model = "pooling"
)
summary(model2)

# Model 3: Route fixed effects
model3 <- plm(
  deviation ~ scheduled_headway + peak + direction,
  data = gtfs,
  model = "within",
  effect = "individual"
)
summary(model3)

# Model 4: Two-way fixed effects (route + day)
model4 <- plm(
  deviation ~ scheduled_headway + peak + direction,
  data = gtfs,
  model = "within",
  effect = "twoways"
)
summary(model4)

# Output Table
stargazer(model1, model2, model3, model4,
          type = "html",
          out = "table2_ols.html",
          title = "Table 2: Deviation (Minutes)",
          column.labels = c("OLS", "Day FE", "Rote FE", "Two-Way FE"),
          covariate.labels = c("Agency: MTA", "Agency: WMATA",
                               "Scheduled Headway", "Peak Hour",
                               "Direction (Inbound)", "N Stops",
                               "Timepoint Rate", "Route Length (mi)",
                               "Headway CV"),
          add.lines = list(
            c("Day Fixed Effects", "No", "Yes", "No", "Yes"),
            c("Route Fixed Effects", "No", "No", "Yes", "Yes")
          ),
          omit = "day_of_week",
          omit.stat = c("f", "ser"),
          digits = 4,
          notes = "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses.",
          notes.append = TRUE)

```

```{r regressions 2}
# Model 5: Agency x headway interaction, day FE
model5 <- plm(
  deviation ~ agency + scheduled_headway + agency:scheduled_headway +
    peak + direction + n_stops + timepoint_rate + route_length_mi + headway_cv +
    day_of_week,
  data = gtfs,
  model = "pooling"
)
summary(model5)

# Model 6: Logistic regression with bunching as outcome
model6 <- glm(
  bunching ~ agency + scheduled_headway + peak + direction +
    n_stops + timepoint_rate + route_length_mi + headway_cv,
  data = gtfs,
  family = "binomial"
)

summary(model6)

marginal_effects <- margins(model6) # getting the marginl effects
summary(marginal_effects)
plot(marginal_effects) # plotting the avg. marginal effects

cplot(model6, "scheduled_headway",
      what = "prediction",
      main = "Predicted Probability of Bunching by Scheduled Headway",
      xlab = "Scheduled Headway (minutes)",
      ylab = "Predicted Probability of Bunching")


stargazer(model5, model6,
          type = "html",
          out = "table3_extensions.html",
          title = "Table 3: Agency Comparison and Logistic Models",
          column.labels = c("Model 5 (OLS)", "Model 6 (Logit)"),
          model.names = FALSE,
          covariate.labels = c("Agency: MTA", "Agency: WMATA",
                               "Scheduled Headway", "Peak Hour",
                               "Direction (Inbound)", "N Stops",
                               "Timepoint Rate", "Route Length (mi)",
                               "Headway CV",
                               "MTA x Headway",
                               "WMATA x Headway"),
          add.lines = list(
            c("Day Fixed Effects", "Yes", "No"),
            c("Route Fixed Effects", "No", "No")
          ),
          omit = "day_of_week",
          omit.stat = c("f", "ser"),
          digits = 3,
          notes = "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. Model 6 reports log-odds coefficients.",
          notes.append = TRUE)

saveRDS(gtfs, "/Users/ahmadalexander/Desktop/python/eco590/final-project-Ahmad-Alexander/data/bus_bunching.rds")
cat("saved\n")
```
